title: Submit a ticket — round 6: the new slider, plain-words failures, Git review and Open tasks

steps.headline: The volume slider now has a round handle with the fill wrapping around it, like Home Assistant's.
steps.changed: The thin browser slider became the app's own: a thick track, the accent fill up to the handle, its end curving around the round handle.
steps.notice: Drags, clicks and arrow keys work as before.

steps.headline: Every glass slider uses the same new slider.
steps.changed: All seven: panel blur and see-through, bubble blur and see-through, terminal see-through, blur and brightness.
steps.notice: The ones the theme fixes still show faded and can't be moved.

steps.path: Settings → Sound, or Appearance → Additional customizations → Fine-tune glass
steps.hint: Open Settings (the gear, top left) → Sound, and drag the Volume slider. Then try Appearance → Additional customizations → Fine-tune glass.
steps.headline: Try the new slider: drag it, click along it, and use the arrow keys.
steps.changed: The practice app, with the new slider in Sound and in Fine-tune glass.

steps.path: Contribute → Open it, when the conversation can't start
steps.headline: When the conversation won't open, it now says so in plain words — no technical error in the message.
steps.changed: Was "The conversation didn't open. spawn claude ENOENT …". Now: the new conversation didn't open, the code is still on this computer, and trying again picks up where it left off.
steps.notice: The technical reason is still there for a bug report, folded under Details.

steps.headline: Details opens to show the technical reason, for anyone who needs it.
steps.changed: The raw text the app got, in small type, inside the Details box.

steps.headline: A failed download reads the same way: what happened, that nothing was left behind, and Try again.
steps.changed: Was the download error with git's own words in the message. Now plain words; with no network it says that instead.
steps.notice: The practice picture now uses the kind of error a real failure gives, not a tidied-up one.

steps.headline: Details holds git's own message for a failed download.
steps.changed: The raw text, folded away until opened.

steps.path: A file in Session files → Review changes → a commit, pointed at
steps.headline: A commit card now lights as one box when pointed at — no band ending in a hard line.
steps.changed: The header used to light alone and stop above the changes.
steps.notice: This screen now has a practice picture, so it can be checked from now on. On YouCoded Night the highlight is too faint to see in either picture.

steps.headline: Open tasks' Completed and Marked inactive sections are now the app's folded rows — no line across the popup.
steps.changed: They were bare words with a count and a small arrow, and a full-width line above "Marked inactive". Now each is a box that opens inside itself, its count under its name.
steps.notice: Pictured with practice tasks; the practice app had none before.

steps.path: A Page you or your assistant build (the Pages kit's slider)
steps.headline: Should sliders inside Pages get the same new look?
steps.today: Pages people build use the Pages kit, whose slider is still the browser's thin one.
steps.problem: A Page would look different from the rest of the app wherever it has a slider.
steps.proposal: Yes: the Pages kit's slider gets the round handle and wrapped fill too (Pages update automatically). No: Pages keep the browser's slider.
